name: madr-decisions
description: Records decisions in MADR, and keeps them readable as history. Generates the record instead of describing the format, so its shape is never recalled from memory. Supersedes a decision by writing a new one and flipping a single line of the old, because a record rewritten to match today's code destroys the only account of what was decided. Moves a record through proposed, accepted, rejected and deprecated, and asks a person before it accepts one. Then refuses the edit which started all this: once a record is settled, a hook turns down both Edit and the shell, and says which command to run instead.
